2608.28439.title: Fidelity Is Not Enough: Dispatch-Level Instrumentation for Agentic Datasheet Extraction
2608.28439.paper_summary: One model passed our fidelity check without ever opening the datasheet. We found it while qualifying models for an internal extraction service: a structured-output constraint had silently disabled tool use, and the model answered anyway, with fabricated source text. Only the per-tool trace exposed it. Fidelity -- whether an extracted value matches the source -- is the standard measure for agentic document extraction, and it scores that run a success. We therefore log every tool call in an agentic benchmark of 25 hand-curated claims over three components, with 12 more on a fourth, 37 in all. From that dispatch record we build two instruments: a rule-based failure-attribution classifier, and a silent-failure detector whose two rules check only which tools were called, never the extracted value. The detector raises no flag on 207 clean fidelity-passing extractions across three model families, and recovers all 50 planted faults that withhold exactly the tools its rules check. The two results are not symmetric: the first bounds the false-positive rate, the second is recall by construction, and detection power against runs that call their tools and still answer wrongly is unmeasured. A second, independent oracle, a causal chamber that tests whether the datasheet's claims hold under physical measurement, is intentionally partial: it confirms only what the apparatus can exercise, a verifiable envelope of 2 of those 37 claims, and we give a taxonomy of why the rest are not physically gradable. Under a controlled perturbation, fidelity passes throughout while the chamber verdict flips exactly at the measurement uncertainty. Across three deployed model stacks (one destabilised by its serving stack, not by any capability gap) the tool layer buys portability and observability rather than accuracy, and earns its premium only once a document outgrows the context window.
2608.28439.paper_summary_zh: 有一個模型在未打開數據表的情況下通過了我們的忠實度檢查。我們在為內部提取服務進行模型驗證時發現了它：一個結構化輸出約束默默地禁用了工具使用，而該模型仍然用虛構的源文本作出回答。只有每個工具的追蹤才揭示了這一點。忠實度——提取的值是否與源匹配——是代理文檔提取的標準衡量指標，並且該運行被評為成功。因此，我們在一個包含25個手動策劃的聲明的代理基準中記錄每個工具調用，這些聲明涵蓋三個組件，第四個組件上還有12個，總共37個。從該調度記錄中，我們構建了兩個工具：一個基於規則的失敗歸因分類器，以及一個靜默失敗檢測器，其兩條規則僅檢查調用了哪些工具，從不檢查提取的值。該檢測器在三個模型系列中對207個乾淨的忠實度通過提取沒有提出任何警告，並恢復了所有50個隱藏的故障，這些故障正好隱藏了其規則檢查的工具。這兩個結果並不對稱：第一個界定了假陽性率，第二個則是由構造決定的召回率，對於調用其工具卻仍然錯誤回答的運行的檢測能力尚未測量。第二個獨立的神諭，一個因果室，測試數據表的聲明在物理測量下是否成立，故意是部分的：它僅確認設備可以驗證的內容，即這37個聲明中的2個可驗證的範圍，我們提供了一個分類法來解釋其餘的為什麼不能進行物理評估。在受控擾動下，忠實度在整個過程中通過，而該室的判決正好在測量不確定性時翻轉。在三個部署的模型堆棧中（其中一個因其服務堆棧而不穩定，而不是因為任何能力差距），工具層購買了可攜性和可觀察性，而不是準確性，並且僅在文檔超出上下文窗口時才獲得其溢價。
2608.28439.author: Qing Ye et.al.
